subject: english
title: Signal Words · Q2 W05 D01
objective: Identify words that show order, reason, contrast, or result in a text.
introduction: Milo is writing a story about his day! Find the signal words that connect the ideas: first, because, and so.

vocabulary.definition: A signal word that tells which event comes before the others.
A signal word that introduces a reason.
A signal word that shows a contrast.

items.prompt: Which sentence links the ideas with a signal word?

options.text: It rained, so the plants grew.
The sun came out at noon.

items.explanation: “So” is the signal word: it shows that the plants growing was the result of the rain.

items.prompt: Which sentence shows the result of warming ice?

options.text: The ice is in a cup.
The ice warmed, so it melted.

items.explanation: The word so links the reason (warming ice) to the result (it melted).

items.prompt: Which sentence shows a result of practicing?
items.explanation: The word so shows the result: Milo improved because he practiced.

items.prompt: Which sentence connects the bell ringing to what happened next?

options.text: The bell hangs on the wall.
The bell rang, so class began.

items.explanation: The word so shows that class began because the bell rang.

items.prompt: Which choice uses a connection word correctly?

options.text: The sun came out at noon.
It rained, so the plants grew.

items.explanation: Only this sentence uses a signal word: so shows the result of the rain.
